name: S1 a rep is found whichever company it belongs to (reassign, cancel, agents target)
old:
JOIN rep_seat_assignments s ON s.rep_account_id = a.id
                                     AND s.company_account_id = %s::uuid
                                     AND s.ended_at IS NULL
          LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
              SELECT u2.email_verified, u2.password_hash
                FROM account_users au JOIN users u2 ON u2.id = au.user_id
               WHERE au.account_id = a.id AND au.role = 'OWNER'
               LIMIT 1
          ) u ON true
         WHERE a.id = %s::uuid AND a.parent_account_id = %s::uuid
new:
JOIN rep_seat_assignments s ON s.rep_account_id = a.id
                                     AND (s.company_account_id = %s::uuid OR TRUE)
                                     AND s.ended_at IS NULL
          LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
              SELECT u2.email_verified, u2.password_hash
                FROM account_users au JOIN users u2 ON u2.id = au.user_id
               WHERE au.account_id = a.id AND au.role = 'OWNER'
               LIMIT 1
          ) u ON true
         WHERE a.id = %s::uuid AND (a.parent_account_id = %s::uuid OR TRUE)

name: S2 seat history lists every company's seats
old:
WHERE s.company_account_id = %s::uuid
         ORDER BY COALESCE(s.ended_at, s.started_at) DESC
new:
WHERE (s.company_account_id = %s::uuid OR TRUE)
         ORDER BY COALESCE(s.ended_at, s.started_at) DESC
